user.title: Connect to Monita
user.description: Enter the Channel application token used by Home Assistant to send notifications. Optionally add a client token to enable realtime inbound messages. Current Monita servers identify the Channel automatically.

data_description.server_url: Base URL of the Monita server.
data_description.app_token: Application token for the Channel used by Home Assistant to send messages.
data_description.client_token: Optional Monita client token. Required only for realtime inbound/two-way messages.
data_description.verify_ssl: Disable only for a trusted private server using a self-signed or otherwise untrusted certificate.

channel.title: Choose the Monita Channel
channel.description: This server does not expose application-token identity. If a client token was supplied, choose the Channel associated with the application token. Otherwise enter a display name.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Monita
reauth_confirm.description: The stored Monita credentials are no longer accepted. Replace the application token and, if needed, the client token.

data_description.client_token: Leave blank to keep the existing client token.
data_description.remove_client_token: Removes inbound/two-way access and disables the inbound stream.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Monita
reconfigure.description: Update network, display, and optional inbound-message settings for this Monita Channel.

data_description.client_token: Leave blank to keep the existing client token.
data_description.remove_client_token: Removes inbound/two-way access and disables the inbound stream.

error.invalid_url: Enter a valid http:// or https:// Monita server URL.
error.rate_limited: Monita rate limited the validation request. Try again shortly.
error.channel_not_accessible: The configured client token cannot access this Monita Channel.
error.wrong_channel: The application token belongs to a different Monita Channel.

abort.already_configured: This Monita Channel is already configured.
abort.setup_state_lost: Setup state was lost. Start the integration setup again.
abort.channel_not_found: The selected Monita Channel is no longer available.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: The supplied settings identify a different Monita Channel.

init.title: Monita options
init.description: Native pairing status: {native_state}. Choose what you want to manage.

settings.title: Monita options
settings.description: Control notification priority and realtime inbound message handling.

data_description.default_priority: Default Gotify priority used by the notify entity.
data_description.inbound_enabled: Maintain a Monita WebSocket connection and expose incoming Channel messages as a Home Assistant event entity.

native_pairing.title: Native Home Assistant pairing
native_pairing.description: Status: Paired. The native bridge can exchange Home Assistant events with Monita without a Home Assistant Long-Lived Access Token.

native_pair.title: Pair with Monita server
native_pair.description: Enter the one-time pairing code generated by Monita. The code expires after 15 minutes and can only be used once. Home Assistant detected {auto_url}; leave the Home Assistant URL blank to use it, or enter an override that Monita can reach.

data_description.home_assistant_url: Optional callback base URL override. Leave blank to use Home Assistant's detected URL.

native_remove.title: Remove native pairing
native_remove.description: Home Assistant will revoke the native bridge on Monita before removing its local credentials. The normal Monita notification integration remains configured.

data.force_local_remove: Force local removal if remote revoke fails

data_description.force_local_remove: Recovery option only. This removes Home Assistant's local native credentials even if Monita cannot be reached or rejects the stored bridge secret.

error.invalid_pairing_code: The Monita pairing code is invalid or was already used.
error.pairing_expired: The Monita pairing code has expired. Generate a new code in Monita.
error.pairing_failed: Monita could not complete native pairing. Generate a new pairing code and try again.
error.invalid_ha_url: Enter a valid http:// or https:// Home Assistant URL reachable by Monita.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to Monita to complete native pairing.
error.rate_limited: Monita rate limited the pairing request. Try again shortly.
error.unpair_auth_failed: Monita rejected the stored native bridge credential. Repair pairing first, or use force local removal if the remote connection has already been replaced.
error.unpair_not_found: Monita could not find the native bridge revoke endpoint or connection. Upgrade Monita, or use force local removal only if you have removed the remote connection separately.
error.cannot_unpair: Could not reach Monita to revoke the native bridge. Try again, or use force local removal only if you will clean up the remote connection separately.
error.unpair_failed: Monita could not revoke the native bridge.

send.name: Send notification
send.description: Send a text, Markdown, or hosted image notification through a configured Monita Channel.

native_bridge_auth_failed.title: Monita native bridge needs repair
native_bridge_auth_failed.description: Monita rejected the stored native bridge credential for {name}. Open Settings → Devices & services → Monita, choose Configure → Native Home Assistant pairing → Repair pairing, generate a new one-time pairing code in Monita, and pair the connection again.
